derivedFrom: e2e/polish/fixtures/stomp/quiz-bowl-classic/proctor.json frame 3 (real, IN_GAME) for gameSettings/playerList/teamList/proctor and the one real full packet object with an id+tossups+bonuses (only ever sent to the real proctor seat).
_meta.note: s3.ts's own header (M5 H0 follow-up, pre-dating this file) found that no record-stomp.ts recording contains a CONFIG-phase frame for the seats it checked (quiz-bowl-classic proctor/buzzer). That turned out to be true for quiz-bowl-classic/proctor.json specifically (its earliest GameSessionUpdate, frame 3, is already IN_GAME) but NOT true fleet-wide: quiz-bowl-classic/spectator.json frame 0, auto-proctor/buzzer.json frame 1 and free-for-all/buzzer.json frames 0+2 are all genuinely-real, unsynthesized CONFIG frames (see config-quiz-bowl-classic/{player,spectator}.json and s3.ts's use of auto-proctor/buzzer.json directly for config-owner-view). This file exists only because the *proctor* seat specifically (id+tossups+bonuses packet visibility, one-team/many-team roster shapes) has no real CONFIG frame at all -- every frame below patches matchState back to CONFIG on top of quiz-bowl-classic/proctor.json's real frame 3, changing only the field(s) each frame's own comment in this script names (see build_config_fixtures.py in the M5 session scratchpad, or this note) -- gameSettings, playerList identities, proctor-claim state and the packet's own tossup/bonus content (where kept) are the real recording's, not invented. S3-18 r3 follow-up (AY): frame 5 (config-many-teams-12-players) originally split its 12 real players 5/4/2/1 across 4 teams, which never actually exercised a 12+-player single roster (S3-27's own concern). Team 1 now holds all 12 original players verbatim (same ids/names, just regrouped); three new filler players (Morgan/Noor/Oscar, h0-config-filler-08..10) were added so Teams 2-4 still each seat one player, keeping >=2 teams populated. Nothing about the other 5 frames changed.
